name: misaka-network
description: Top-level wrapper for the misaka-network test suite. Not a workspace — each sub-project (client/ server/) keeps its own package.json and lockfile. This file only orchestrates `npm test` and a CI guard script.

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
